authority: Selective capability projection of the pinned OpenMontage external runtime vendor. Extends the existing capability registry and single router. Does not create a second registry, scheduler, orchestrator, provenance store, or OpenMontage-specific governance ontology. OpenMontage pipeline/orchestration concepts are NOT imported into P2P; P2P retains authority/orchestrator ownership (Control Tower, Work Factory, risk lanes, capability routing, ReturnPacket, Supervisor, Owner Gate).

lifecycle_vocabulary.note: Canonical P2P status/readiness vocabulary is authoritative (STATUS=DISCOVERED; readiness INSTALLED/DISCOVERED/ELIGIBLE/RESOLVED/EXECUTABLE/HEALTHY). The five requested projection states are annotated per group only; no new registry enum was created.
lifecycle_vocabulary.DISCOVERED: Upstream capability identified at exact pin; canonical STATUS=DISCOVERED; canonical readiness DISCOVERED=true.
lifecycle_vocabulary.PROJECTABLE: Upstream tool/pipeline identity is known well enough to project as a bounded P2P work item. Static source inspection only - no runtime proof implied.
lifecycle_vocabulary.EXECUTION_REGISTERED: False for every group: no P2P adapter invokes OpenMontage; nothing is wired into P2P execution.
lifecycle_vocabulary.EXECUTION_AUTHORIZED: False for every group: no Owner Gate approval exists; no keys, no GPU budget, no runtime.
lifecycle_vocabulary.RUNTIME_PROVEN: False for every group: OpenMontage was not installed or executed in this workstream, so execution readiness is never claimed.

projected_groups.name: OpenMontage external video-production vendor (umbrella)
projected_groups.description: Single selective route to the pinned OpenMontage vendor as an external production capability provider. Everything below is scoped by this umbrella; P2P retains authority.

projected_groups.name: Real-footage documentary montage
projected_groups.description: Retrieval-first thematic montage built from free/open archival + stock footage; CLIP-indexed corpus; narrative-beat edit; music sync; uniform color grade. Zero-paid-key route.
projected_groups.runtime_class: LOCAL_FREE (archive/NASA/Wikimedia, no key) + FREE_SOURCE_OR_FREE_KEY (Pexels/Pixabay/Unsplash free keys)

projected_groups.name: Animated explainer / character animation
projected_groups.description: Research -> script -> narration -> asset -> scene plan -> render explainer flow, plus local SVG/GSAP character animation. Zero-paid-key path uses Piper + generated/reference images + Remotion/HyperFrames.
projected_groups.runtime_class: LOCAL_FREE (Piper, Remotion, HyperFrames, FFmpeg) with optional PAID_API image providers

projected_groups.name: Composition / rendering runtimes
projected_groups.description: Remotion (React), HyperFrames (HTML/GSAP), and FFmpeg composing/stitching/trimming. P2P may select a composition capability group without selecting generation providers.
projected_groups.runtime_class: LOCAL_FREE (CPU: Node + FFmpeg; no API key)

projected_groups.name: Audio: narration, mixing, enhancement, music/SFX
projected_groups.description: Offline Piper TTS plus scored cloud TTS selectors; audio mixing/enhancement; music and SFX selectors (local library, free-key, paid).

projected_groups.name: Media sourcing (free/open archives and stock)
projected_groups.description: StockSource adapter protocol over Archive.org, NASA, Wikimedia Commons, Pexels, Pixabay, Unsplash; corpus building and direct clip search.

projected_groups.name: Analysis / QA / media validation + subtitles
projected_groups.description: ffprobe/media validation, transcription, scene detection, frame sampling, video understanding, audio-level validation, visual QA checkpoint flow, subtitle generation (SRT/VTT/word-level).

deferred_groups.name: Image/video generation providers
deferred_groups.reason: Predominantly PAID_API (fal.ai, OpenAI, xAI, Kling, Seedance, Runway, HeyGen, etc.) or LOCAL_GPU (WAN/Hunyuan/CogVideo/LTX/local diffusion). Not part of zero-paid-key projection. Provider calls and keys are out of scope for vendor intake; P2P would need an owner-gated paid/GPU envelope before any projection.

deferred_groups.name: Avatar spokesperson / talking head / lip sync
deferred_groups.reason: Avatar-spokesperson and talking-head pipelines map to paid avatar providers (Kling avatar/lip-sync) or external local repositories (SadTalker, Wav2Lip) that are cloned/installed separately. Not part of the minimal zero-key projection; requires owner-gated runtime decision.

deferred_groups.name: Screen demo, cinematic, clip factory, podcast repurpose, hybrid, localization/dub
deferred_groups.reason: Useful but beyond the smallest useful projection for intake. Screen demo/repurpose/clip factory are largely LOCAL_FREE but need source footage and device capture surfaces; cinematic/hybrid blend paid generation; localization/dub is narration-heavy (paid TTS for many languages) with subtitles covered by the quality group. Deferred to a later project-selective routing pass.

deferred_groups.name: Enhancement (upscale, bg remove, face enhance/restore, color grade)
deferred_groups.reason: LOCAL_FREE with optional GPU, but requires extra packages (realesrgan, gfpgan, rembg) and model weights; deferred with generation/GPU envelope.

zero_paid_key_route.summary: Documentary montage (or explainer) via open archives + Pixel-based free keys + Piper narration + Remotion/HyperFrames/FFmpeg composition + built-in subtitles + ffprobe/audio QA.
verified_static_evidence: docs/PROVIDERS.md: 'archive.org, nasa, and wikimedia work without API keys'
docs/PROVIDERS.md: Piper 'no API key, no cost, no network'
docs/PROVIDERS.md: Remotion 'Free. Always local.'; HyperFrames 'Free. Always local.'

local_gpu_route.summary: Not projected. Provided by upstream as LOCAL_GPU (make install-gpu; WAN 2.1/2.2, Hunyuan 1.5, CogVideo, LTX-2 local, local diffusion, ComfyUI local workflows). P2P would require an owner-gated envelope; no GPU install in this workstream.
local_gpu_route.upstream_evidence: requirements-gpu.txt, docs/PROVIDERS.md local video generation section, tools/video/_wan_engine.py

paid_api_route.summary: Not projected. Providers are documented but no key is used and no provider is called. Cost reporting exists upstream (cost_tracker.py estimate/reserve/reconcile; budget observe/warn/cap; per-action approval; cost_log artifacts).
paid_api_route.upstream_evidence: tools/cost_tracker.py, config.yaml budget block, schemas/artifacts/cost_log.schema.json, docs/PROVIDERS.md

p2p_authority_boundary.work_item_flow: P2P WORK_ITEM -> OpenMontage vendor adapter (future, not registered) -> selected OpenMontage production pipeline/tools -> durable video/assets/evidence -> normalized P2P ReturnPacket

LICENSE_GATES: AGPL-3.0 upstream verified; no upstream source/implementation code copied into P2P core
reference-only pin record; no AGPL source snapshot
any future vendor adapter must remain a thin boundary (no import of OpenMontage implementation logic)
commercial_clearance NOT_ASSESSED; no license compatibility claim beyond license text
RUNTIME_GATES: no install (pip/npm/make) until owner-gated runtime envelope
no execution before RUNTIME_PROVEN via isolated runtime evidence
no paid provider calls from P2P; no API keys accepted
no local GPU/model download unless owner-gated
no claim of execution readiness from static source inspection
SECURITY_GATES: agentic custom-script surface (12/13 pipelines custom_scripts=true) requires isolated sandbox before any execution
network access is expected during provider runtime; P2P-side network policy remains DENY until owner-gated
subprocess/download surfaces (50 subprocess sites, 99 download-related files) require containment
